summary: Target Hospitality filed an 8-K detailing a September 8, 2026 underwriting agreement tied to a secondary offering by Arrow Holdings and MFA Global (TDR Capital-controlled), covering 14,000,000 shares at $18.50, plus a 2,100,000-share greenshoe, with no company proceeds. Concurrently, Target will repurchase roughly $30 million of shares at the same price, funded with cash and ABL borrowings, held as treasury. Morgan Stanley, Deutsche Bank and J.P. Morgan are representatives. Watch deal pricing pressure, lockup signals and whether the buyback absorbs enough supply to limit overhang.
